about_the_game:
Play as Monk the Sasquatch, Rosa the Chupacabra and Guppy the Lake Monster, a team of private eye detectives operating in the shadows of the Cryptid Underground, off the grid from human detection. Swap characters on the go (or by taking a hit) to tackle any challenge thrown your way. Whether it's government agents, vicious enemies, or just a particularly large pit, each teammate's unique moves and abilities are sure to come in handy!

 

Get ready for 2D platforming at its best! Run, jump, and drive your way through a variety of locales. From the seedy Cryptid Underground to the human world above. Collect clues, gather evidence files, find hidden secrets, and earn cold hard cash along the way. You'll need to be quick on your feet to stay alive long enough to crack this case!

A crazy cast of characters, wacky story, engaging levels and more await! So what are you waiting for? Time to get on the case!

short_description: Cryptid Eye is a classic 2D Platformer where you play as a team of private detectives – Bigfoot, Chupacabra, Lake Monster – each with their own unique set of skills. Run, jump, collect evidence files and fight brutal bosses in a fast-paced race to crack the case!
